newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel Corp completes Piryon offer.
newsitem.headline: Israel Corp completes Piryon offer.

text.p: Israel Corp said on Tuesday it had completed its second general offer for shares it did not already control in Piryon Investment Trust Co.
Israel Corp, an investment holding company, said it acquired a further 6.1 percent of Piryon, a holding company with interests in textiles and commerce, and now owns 96.12 percent of equity.
Israel Corp paid 95 shekels per share, or a total of 9.4 million shekels, and will offer the same terms to the remaining outside shareholders.

In its first offer made in August, Israel Corp acquired 43.3 percent of Piryon at the same price. It said it plans to delist Piryon because the two companies' activities are so similar. ($1 = 3.19 shekels)
